context: Asuka lectures on life and climate.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: biology lecture; vocabulary (生物/温度/骨/描か/馬) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 生物は、温度の変化に適応します。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 馬のような動物も、ですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、馬も寒さに合わせて進化しました。
lines.en: Yes, horses evolved to suit the cold.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 骨の形でも、それが分かりますか?
lines.en: Can we tell that from bone shape too?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 骨を調べれば、生活が描かれます。
lines.en: By studying bones, their life is depicted.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 温度の記録も、残っているんですか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 氷に、当時の温度が描かれています。
lines.en: The ice records the temperature of that time.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 生物と温度、深くつながっていますね。
lines.en: Organisms and temperature are deeply linked.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
